It’s the weekend but surprised I missed this from $ORCL earnings.

Implications for $NBIS to $IREN are pretty positive since:

Oracle said all GPU capacity for renewal were resold +20% premium above previous contracts.

Majority of the equipment was 4Y+ and older…

So another L for the Burry’s rapid GPU depreciation thesis.

And W for $NVDA and the Neocloud party.
@aleabitoreddit Curious what you think of Dario, Sam & Elon all agreeing we need to pace/slow the AI frontier?

@x4tsr Not gonna happen. I see this as more regulatory capture, there’s no way Anthropic/OpenAI would slow down to let others catch up.

Or have US to slow down and allow China to secretly leapfrog in AI capability.

One of the downsides in AI getting so good is that it is getting harder to demonstrate its strengths and weaknesses. Yes, Astra and Fable can research and write good papers in an academic field. No, they are not as good as human (yet?), but you have to know the field to know why.

@emollick AI can make expertise look easy.
Knowing when it’s wrong is still expertise.
It was much easier when you could point to hallucinated sources or obvious mistakes or whatever. That doesn't really happen much anymore.
